title: Pilot ring covers too few or too many devices
when: Pct(it.TargetedDeviceCount, Facts.Devices.WindowsCount) < params.minPct || Pct(it.TargetedDeviceCount, Facts.Devices.WindowsCount) > params.maxPct

maxPct.text: Above this the pilot is the estate

minPct.text: Below this the pilot proves little

messages.businessImpact: A pilot too small will not surface hardware-specific problems; one too large means a bad update affects most of the organisation anyway.
remediation: Aim for between one and ten per cent of Windows devices, chosen to cover the hardware models in use.
messages.cannotSee: Which ring is the pilot is read from its name, because Intune marks no ring as one: against the pilot-ring pattern of the customer's naming convention file where it sets one, and a pattern the pack carries otherwise. A tenant that names its rings something the pattern does not recognise has no pilot as far as this rule is concerned, and is passed over rather than reported.
